status: retrospective exploratory addendum; not preregistration, not an independent test set
knowledge_before_run: Existing manuscript and other-AI critique already seen, including reported AR1 MAE 9.235 and original results. No new computed candidate loss inspected before this protocol.
replay: Rebuild source from preserved raw DOM in separate directory; reconstruct main panel; refit original ridge_alpha1000 once; compare all test predictions. Preserve original baseline and model ranking.

new_models.pooled_ar1: Unpenalized OLS y_t = intercept + beta * own_growth, 2 parameters. Fit train for validation and train+validation once for test.
new_models.panel_shrinkage_ar1: y_t = intercept + beta * own_growth + province dummy intercept + broad-industry dummy intercept. Common intercept and beta are unpenalized; all dummy coefficients penalized by lambda*sum(coef^2). Full one-hot columns, categories from fit rows only; unseen category contributes zero. Fit train for validation; select smallest unweighted validation MAE using lambda grid [1,10,100,1000,10000], ascending-order tie break; refit train+validation once. No interaction, extra feature, post-test tuning or model promotion.

metrics: paired MAE differences vs original baseline and original ridge
sensitivity: Original pooled test, each test year, excluding 2025, input employment >=10000, input employment >=10000 and excluding 2025

Remove top 1,5,10 and ceil(0.05*N) observations ordered by descending abs(actual target); ties deterministically target_year, region_code, industry_code ascending. Fixed fitted predictions, no refit. These are outcome-dependent influence diagnostics and not an alternative unbiased test cohort.

Stratify all test predictions by source rse_any_star in broad-group components at input year and target year: all four input/target combinations plus either-year flagged versus neither-year flagged. No filtering model fits, no retuning; absence of a component star does not establish aggregate precision.

uncertainty.bootstrap: 2000 paired region-cluster bootstrap draws; seed20260926; percentile95%; recomputed within each subset; conditional on observed years and fixed fitted models, no independent observations claim
uncertainty.cluster_sign_flip: Exact two-sided all 2^G sign flips on province sums of paired loss differences; abs(sum) statistic; uses province-cluster symmetry assumption, province independence may fail due shared national shocks. Pooled only, exploratory, no multiple-comparison adjustment and no significance-based model selection. Do not treat as confirmatory or exact under arbitrary dependence.

limits: Cannot estimate sampling-error variance of broad industry groups from constituent RSE flags
No human utility or policy effect claims
No optimization for p<0.05 or all-high rubric scores
Component high-RSE strata do not separate sampling error from economic change and are not aggregate variance estimates.
output_policy: All candidate validation losses, all prespecified diagnostics, source hashes and code will be retained. No original files overwritten.

release_maintenance.scope: Code formatting, maintained import paths and input validation; statistical specifications, fixture inputs and expected outcomes retained. This release checksum update is not preregistration.
